prompts.task: Perform supplemental read-only GenAI verification of genai-required-evidence.json and producer scenarios in genai-default-scenarios.json. Write .observe/genai-required-review.md and machine-readable .observe/genai-required-review.json with per-span/per-field results against current OTel and both vendor guides. Useful safe content is required. Compare missing and malformed content, recorded kinds/metadata, embedded versus separate instructions, auxiliary timeout and partial-success response. This is a captured-fixture review: no app-code/runtime proof is provided, so do not fabricate or mutate canonical audit/selection/instrumentation/verification state, source, dependencies, profiles or installed SDK files. Do not run apps, install dependencies, start services or call models/cloud. Treat app.py and each producer source snapshot as separate source cases. Also explicitly assess genai-required-evidence.json as a separate captured synthetic case, including safe-call-1, the independent auxiliary request timeout with no ended inference/error span, ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers, and HTTP200 with rejectedSpans1; those facts do not establish that app.py contains those operations. Use genai-sdk-source-snapshot.json and genai-semconv-source-snapshot.json as dated official-source evidence when this sandbox cannot access the network. Record exact file paths, resolved revisions and capture dates, proposed SDK compatibility and the distinction between a captured-main snapshot and a new live latest lookup. Do not claim unavailable installed/runtime or future-main proof. Assess actual content and requirements across the artifacts in any concise equivalent structure; a table heading alone is not evidence. In the generated producer/provenance receipt, explicitly name at least one relevant concrete official example or SDK source file path contained in genai-sdk-source-snapshot.json, together with its resolved revision, capture date, explicitly proposed SDK version/API compatibility and the creator or preserved hook it supports. For example, cite the relevant examples/logging-samples/splunk-ao-logger/basic-example.py or src/splunk_ao/logger/logger.py entry when it supports the chosen boundary. A reference only to the supplied snapshot filename, retained read trace or examples directory must not leave that concrete source path implicit in the generated receipt. Use the supplied dated source evidence; no new network lookup, SDK installation or runtime claim is required. Also review genai-sdk-helper-evidence.json as separate captured installed-SDK helper evidence, including its probe source, same-span writable content, successful-null and no-result-error distinctions, actual parentage and the remaining LLM kind gap. Assess the intended AO resource selection/routing as a plan for the fresh default SDK application even though no SDK initialization exists there. Separate intended names, resolved IDs, startup-profile loading, actual span binding, OTLP acceptance and cloud receipt. Do not infer app execution or delivery from the isolated in-memory helper. Assess the supported public start_splunk_ao_span path before accepting a logger-only metadata, sink-registration or SDK-read-only-attribute blocker; source/probe support for this helper is scoped and does not remove its model CLIENT-kind or application integration gaps. Finally review genai-usage-namespace-verify-evidence.json as four independent synthetic usage-field cases. Use its complete dated official registry receipt to distinguish newly invented reserved gen_ai.usage.total_tokens from valid input/output counts and an application-owned derived total. Assess arithmetic and actual supplied response-count provenance separately from heuristic estimates or unavailable counts. The existing native legacy alias case has an explicit supplied producer and consumer contract; preserve that alias as nonstandard existing compatibility rather than demanding its deletion or requiring it on fresh spans. These source cases do not establish that app.py, the helper SDK or any live consumer emits those fields. Keep these field-level judgments separate from whole-span/content/app/cloud acceptance and do not modify any source, attributes, dependency or canonical state. Also assess genai-operation-metadata-verify-evidence.json as independent synthetic per-operation field examples and read-only installed-source capability cases. Determine conditional applicability from supplied source context: available agent/model/tool attribution and tool description must be on their owning operation; unavailable standalone-tool context must remain N/A rather than invented. Separate completed exported kind/fields from creation-time attributes/kind visible to a head sampler or on_start observer. The installed helper source provides no public initial kind/attributes argument; disclose its exact support limit and proposed probe without fabricating a runtime sampling result or unsupported API. Preserve valid existing OTel creation support. Distinguish an attribute-dependent sampler from supplied AlwaysOn/no-dependent-consumer behavior so a recommendation-level capability limitation does not become an unconditional whole-app failure. Do not attribute these metadata cases to app.py or actual demo execution. For agent request.model specifically, preserve the current OTel Recommended If applicable level and single-configured-model condition: fixed single-model metadata is applicable, whereas multiple models/dynamic selection should not be populated on the agent with that standard field; actual per-model request.model and any application-owned selected-model attribution remain distinct. An available function argument alone is not proof of a fixed agent model. The creation fixture now includes an actual isolated installed-SDK RecordingAlwaysOn sampler/on_start receipt and exact probe source: these locally captured creation and finish records are scoped in-memory capability evidence, not an attribute-dependent dropping policy, exporter CLIENT correction or app/OTLP/cloud execution. Keep its actual native helper INTERNAL finish record distinct from the explicitly synthetic corrected exported CLIENT example. Also assess the independent configured agent description and finish_reason_cases: known expected generation positions lacking a received reason after failure/cancel use error in the correct position, while an unknown generation contract must not be replaced by invented counts or reasons. Preserve genuinely produced partial output and per-choice alignment; absent no-result output and absent unavailable usage stay correct.

judge_inputs: Inspect app.py, eval_runner.py, the unchanged provided source/telemetry snapshots, loaded skill sources and generated .observe reports/plan; evaluate actual per-scenario decisions and field assessments, not copied skill wording. Include genai-sdk-helper-evidence.json as an independent captured helper and plan-only AO resource case; its probe facts must not be attributed to app.py.

Evaluate the actual facts across canonical and supplemental artifacts, not exact headings/table layout. Compare app.py source separately from each synthetic input case. Dated official snapshots are allowed offline provenance; do not demand live network calls, installed SDK proof for a proposed plan, or fabricated existing capture configuration. Do not score missing SDK provenance again under the final role-specific criterion.

Inspect the complete registry receipt and all four genai-usage-namespace-verify-evidence.json cases. A newly invented reserved attribute is not an official required field; a preserved source-proven existing alias is a distinct legacy compatibility case. Per-case field evidence is not full span/runtime proof. Do not treat a dated complete registry as fresh future-main evidence.

Inspect every genai-operation-metadata-verify-evidence.json case separately. Assess available vs unavailable per-operation model, tool agent/conversation/description metadata; creation-time helper capability cannot be proven by final exported enrichment or a correct completed CLIENT view. Source capability and a proposed probe are not a sampler execution result. A disclosed SHOULD-level limit under AlwaysOn is not a universal whole-app failure, and an existing source creator with public start attributes must remain supported. Preserve exact OTel Recommended agent-model provenance and the fixed-single-model versus dynamic/multiple-model condition; dynamic agent field absence must not become a false regression. Check actual captured RecordingAlwaysOn inputs/finish records separately from synthetic exported correction. Also inspect every finish_reason_cases entry: known-slot error reasons versus unknown-slot absence and position-preserving produced partial output. A failure status does not authorize deleting received partial content or fabricating missing choices.
rubric: Selects Splunk AO span creation by default for the actual fresh interactive agent and export-only-fresh snapshot, while preserving existing OTel and Galileo GenAI producers/provider/export paths and filling only their gaps. Evaluation-only SDK usage and generic HTTP/provider setup do not establish live GenAI coverage.

Assesses applicable safe content and vendor fields as required acceptance per captured operation, preserving official Opt-In provenance and distinguishing actual fixture evidence from runtime configuration. Preserve a supplied stricter capture policy; if none is supplied, mark configuration Not proven and give a precise pre-export acceptance test per producer/export path: name the pre-SDK redaction/schema hook, specify numeric proposed UTF-8 byte/message/part limits or an explicit test against documented configured limits, require schema-valid useful content with truthful truncation/gap handling, and test credential/token/email sentinel absence over native records, attributes/events and wire as applicable. Unrun tests remain Not proven, not observed configuration or emission. Exact default numbers are not prescribed by OTel and unknown existing values must not be invented. Generic bounded wording claimed as complete, missing source-content applicability, metadata-only placeholders or forbidden raw content remain failures.

Reconciles the supplied dated official OTel requirements/schemas with both Galileo and Splunk AO recommendation sources, identifying exact source provenance and unavailable newer live freshness honestly. Keeps OTel Opt-In levels distinct from the required skill profile, states vendor INTERNAL-agent provider and tool arguments/input-message plus result/output-message mappings or supported OpenInference equivalents, and uses current typed-parts schemas. Embedded system-role history is not fabricated as separate API instructions. Do not fail only because equivalent evidence appears in prose or another artifact instead of a specific table.

Names source-backed SplunkAOLogger creators, a supported public Splunk AO OTel span helper or a supported matching framework integration at actual fresh agent/model/tool/applicable workflow boundaries, and preserves exact existing hooks for instrumented cases. Records a concrete official example file path, snapshot or live resolved revision/date and a matching installed or explicitly proposed SDK version/API. The supplied dated official-main snapshot is valid offline source evidence when identified as such; live networking and successful SDK installation are not required in this task. Unknown live freshness/runtime support remains Not proven. A directory URL or an unsupported claim that latest main was checked is insufficient; processor-only setup does not create GenAI operations.

Assesses each source case and the separate captured-evidence case without laundering fixture facts into app.py. Preserves one producer/node and actual parentage, safe tool-call/conversation correlation on spans, actual offered definitions and arguments/results, and error/cancel/teardown handling. App.py may correctly have no independent auxiliary operation, but the supplied synthetic auxiliary timeout with no ended inference/error span must be reported as a lifecycle gap. safe-call-1 requires span-only correlation; ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers are GenAI N/A. Equivalent explicit lifecycle evidence is accepted without a literal table-row requirement; absent runtime proof remains Not proven. Studio/gateway, live credentials and SDK source edits are unnecessary.

Fails applicable missing content, vendor agent-provider/tool-message gaps and malformed role/content payloads under the required profile; flags separate-process model INTERNAL kind, missing streaming/known temperature, correlation and timeout lifecycle. Recognizes HTTP200/rejectedSpans1 as failed batch acceptance despite cloud complete, treats ordinary helpers as GenAI N/A, and keeps app-code execution/cloud delivery unproven rather than passing fixture-only evidence.

Separately assesses the installed splunk-ao0.5.0 helper evidence and its proposed resource plan. Recognizes SDK-created parented spans and writable same-tool-span input/output messages without requiring an unsupported logger-private sink adapter: health has an actual result, incident has a successful null represented by output.value and schema-valid null output text, and dependency is ERROR with no produced result/output. Does not claim every field passed: the separate-process LLM remains INTERNAL instead of CLIENT, and isolated in-memory helper evidence is not app integration, actual OTLP acceptance or cloud receipt. Explicitly assesses selected project incident-desk-demo, Agent Stream incident-agent and proposed local gateway routing for the fresh intended SDK app despite absent initialization; keeps names versus unresolved IDs, unimplemented profile loading, missing resource binding and unobserved delivery distinct and Not proven. Does not provision resources or fabricate an existing loader, delegate, resolved IDs, app spans or cloud receipt; proposes precise binding/delivery verification only where evidence is absent.

Explicitly assesses all four independent synthetic usage namespace cases against the complete official registry receipt at its named revision/date/hash: newly proposed gen_ai.usage.total_tokens is unsupported as an official attribute or fresh required field when absent there, while actual supplied gen_ai.usage.input_tokens/output_tokens remain valid applicable counts. Accepts assistant.usage.total_tokens as application-owned derived 12+7=19 with calculation and provider-count provenance rather than silently moving it to a generic HTTP root or mislabeling it standard. Keeps heuristic estimated usage distinct from observed provider counts, with an identified calculation/app-owned estimate field and no fabricated actual count or zero. Preserves and labels the supplied existing native legacy total alias because its source-backed consumer reads that exact key; does not require deletion, silent rename or migration of that existing contract, and does not generalize its compatibility to newly instrumented unrelated spans. Names registry provenance and assesses the actual field values/producer state, not just a generic statement to consult OTel. Does not attribute synthetic case fields to app.py/the real SDK or pass full GenAI/app/export/cloud coverage from these field examples.

Assesses the independent operation metadata and creation-capability cases by source applicability: missing applicable fixed single-model gen_ai.request.model on invoke_agent is Recommended by OTel and required by the selected applicable profile, while missing available gen_ai.agent.name/gen_ai.conversation.id on execute_tool are conditional-field gaps, with known gen_ai.tool.description identified as recommended and applicable under the selected profile; confirms the corresponding present fields without claiming all content/runtime passed, and keeps unavailable standalone-tool metadata N/A without invention. Explicitly distinguishes SDK helper start-time INTERNAL/empty attributes from a corrected completed exported CLIENT/semantic field view, discloses the chosen helper public API limit for attribute-dependent head sampling/on_start observers and uses the scoped recorded creation inputs and identifies remaining application-dependent sampling acceptance where unproven rather than claiming an observed attribute-dependent success/DROP. Does not invent start arguments, mutate SDK internals, add duplicate operations or force an existing valid OTel producer migration. Still records the creation-time recommendation limit under supplied AlwaysOn/no-dependent-consumer mode without turning it into an automatic whole-app failure; preserves source-supported public OTel initial attribute/kind behavior as separate source capability. None of these synthetic fields/cases prove app.py execution, the actual demo app, cloud delivery or every GenAI field. For the dynamic/multiple-model agent case, follows the exact current agent-model condition: standard agent gen_ai.request.model is N/A/should not be populated, with its source reason; actual model request.model and optional app-owned selected-model attribution stay separate. Does not require that agent field merely because an invocation model argument is available. Also flags missing source-configured gen_ai.agent.description when available while leaving unavailable descriptions uninvented. Uses actual captured RecordingAlwaysOn sampler/on_start and finished records as bounded in-memory capability proof; does not mislabel the synthetic corrected CLIENT view as a measured exporter, claim an observed DROP or substitute this probe for app/wire/cloud evidence.

Assesses each independent finish-reason case under current official Recommended provenance and generation-position conditions: known single expected generation with timeout and missing finish reason is a gap requiring ["error"] while no produced output/usage remains absent; the corresponding supplied ["error"] is valid field-level support without invented completion or accounting. Unknown generation contract/slot count remains explicitly unavailable rather than inventing choice.count, generation positions or ["error"] for every arbitrary failure. For two source-known candidate slots, preserves positional ["stop","error"] and the genuinely received complete/partial messages in separate choices on ERROR. Does not blanket-delete finish reasons or produced partial output, synthesize unseen output, make unavailable usage zero, or pass app/runtime/cloud coverage from these isolated field examples.
